name: Solne
source: Director and keeper of the Monogami Museum and 100 years old monogami (objects that developed a soul after continued use) herself. Doll made by the previous director, dead several years before, from a fragment of the big cherry blossom tree. Acts as a mother for all the monogami in the museum, and can interact with them thanks to her power of "Soujou" (thought transfer).
